The B2B Prospecting Problem Was the Workflow

The sales team did not have a lead shortage. They had a workflow problem. Finding useful B2B prospects required too much manual research. Lead information was spread across different sources, and reps had to review prospects one by one before deciding who was worth contacting. A rep could spend around 10 hours each week on research, enrichment, and qualification, which meant less time for actual sales conversations. As prospect volume increased, the process became even harder to manage.

Why Another Lead Tool Was Not Enough

Sales teams already have access to tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, enrichment platforms, and CRM systems. Adding another standalone tool would not connect lead discovery, enrichment, qualification, scoring, and pipeline management. Reps would still switch between tools, copy data, check records, and decide the next step by hand. That is where AI automation services became useful. Lead Scout was built around the client’s actual B2B prospecting workflow. DigiWorks AI’s AI integration services connect AI, business data, and existing sales systems into one process.

The AI Lead Generation Solution

DigiWorks AI developed Lead Scout as an AI-assisted B2B prospecting platform. It helps sales teams find prospects, enrich lead information, prioritize opportunities, and manage the pipeline from one place. The purpose was not to replace the sales team. It was to remove the work around sales so reps could spend more time talking to the right prospects.

01

AI Lead Discovery

Lead Scout helps identify relevant B2B prospects across different data sources. Instead of manually searching for companies and contacts, sales teams can build a more structured prospecting pipeline and handle a higher volume of opportunities.

02

Automated Lead Enrichment

Finding a company is only the first step. Sales teams also need enough information to decide whether a lead is worth pursuing. Lead Scout enriches prospect records with additional business information so reps spend less time checking data manually.

03

AI Lead Scoring and Prioritization

Not every prospect deserves the same amount of attention. Lead Scout uses AI-assisted scoring to help teams identify stronger opportunities. Instead of reviewing every lead in the same way, reps can focus their effort where it is more likely to create value.

04

Centralized Pipeline Management

Lead discovery becomes less useful when the information still lives across several tools. Lead Scout brings prospect information and pipeline stages into one centralized view. Sales teams can organize leads, track progress, and manage follow-ups without constantly moving between separate systems.

05

B2B Prospecting Automation

Lead Scout automates repetitive parts of discovery, enrichment, qualification, and pipeline management. The result is a more repeatable B2B prospecting automation workflow that supports higher lead volume without creating the same increase in manual work.

What DigiWorks AI Custom Built

DigiWorks AI developed the platform around the client’s B2B prospecting workflow rather than relying on a generic lead database. For a broader custom solution, custom software development services can build systems around a specific sales workflow.

From Manual Prospecting to One Sales Workflow

  • Around 35–40% less prospect research time, from about 10 hours to 6–6.5 hours per rep per week.
  • Prospect volume rose from roughly 120–150 to around 200–250 leads per rep each week.
  • The qualified lead rate improved by about 20–25%.
  • The MVP launched in about 10–12 weeks, covering discovery, enrichment, scoring, and pipeline management.
  • Each rep gained roughly 3.5–4 hours per week for outreach, follow-up, and sales conversations.
